segments.text: My manager asked if the release would be ready Friday.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker's manager inquired whether the upcoming work would be finished by Friday.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yöneticim, yeni sürümün Cuma gününe yetişip yetişmeyeceğini sordu.

segments.englishExplanation: The speaker knew that completing the work by Friday was impossible.

segments.text: Two features were still untested, and one depended on a fix from another team.
segments.englishExplanation: The delay was caused by unverified features and a dependency on another team's fix.
segments.turkishExplanation: İki özellik henüz test edilmemişti ve bir diğeri de başka bir ekibin yapacağı düzeltmeye bağlıydı.

segments.text: I didn't want to just say no, so I laid it out.
segments.englishExplanation: Instead of giving a blunt refusal, the speaker explained the details clearly.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sadece "hayır" demek istemedim, bu yüzden durumu detaylarıyla açıkladım.

segments.text: I don't think we'll be able to meet Friday's deadline.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker informed the manager that the target date could not be met.
segments.turkishExplanation: Cuma günkü teslim tarihine yetişebileceğimizi sanmıyorum.

segments.englishExplanation: The speaker transitions into explaining the current progress of the project.
segments.turkishExplanation: Şu anki durumumuz tam olarak bu.

segments.text: Two features need testing, and one is waiting on another team's fix.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker restates the remaining technical tasks in direct terms.
segments.turkishExplanation: İki özelliğin test edilmesi gerekiyor ve biri de başka bir ekibin düzeltmesini bekliyor.

segments.text: She asked, what can you commit to?
segments.englishExplanation: The manager asked for a realistic deadline that the speaker could pledge to meet.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yöneticim, "Hangi tarih için söz verebilirsin?" diye sordu.

segments.englishExplanation: The speaker suggests Monday as the new target date.
The speaker gives a firm promise regarding the Monday completion.
The manager agreed and updated the schedule accordingly.

segments.text: No last -minute scramble, no broken promises.
segments.englishExplanation: Being honest prevented last-minute panic and unmet commitments.
segments.turkishExplanation: Ne son dakika telaşı yaşandı ne de verilen sözler tutulmamış oldu.

vocabulary.gloss: to explain or present facts/details clearly
to complete work by an agreed date or time
to promise or pledge to achieve a goal
a hurried, hectic effort to finish something

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used when presenting facts, plans, or a situation clearly and step-by-step.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir durumu, planı veya gerçekleri detaylı ve anlaşılır bir biçimde ortaya koymak, açıklamak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Before making a decision, she laid out all the options.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Karar vermeden önce tüm seçenekleri detaylıca açıkladı.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: A common professional collocation meaning to finish a task before or on time.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: İş hayatında çok sık kullanılan, bir işi belirlenen son teslim tarihine yetiştirmek anlamına gelen ifade.
learningPoints.exampleEn: We had to work late to meet the deadline.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Teslim tarihine yetişebilmek için geç saatlere kadar çalışmak zorunda kaldık.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To promise formally to deliver a specific outcome or timeline.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Belli bir sonucu veya tarihi teslim edeceğine dair söz vermek, taahhütte bulunmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Don't commit to a date unless you are certain.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Emin olmadığınız sürece belirli bir tarih için söz vermeyin.

quiz.question: In segment 4, what does the speaker mean by "so I laid it out"?

options.text: They explained the current status and issues clearly to the manager.
They requested extra budget to complete the remaining features.
They postponed the project review meeting until the following week.
They handed over the technical responsibilities to another team.
